subject.title: fix(mattermost): backfill thread history from server when in-memory window is empty

question: Should this PR become the canonical Mattermost thread-history recovery fix, and is one bounded inbound thread fetch per history key and stored session id acceptable?
rationale: The patch is viable and well-proven, but three open PRs target the same bug and the added awaited REST fetch is a deliberate channel availability and session-state tradeoff that maintainers should own before landing.

options.title: Refresh And Land This Candidate
options.body: Use this proof-sufficient branch as the canonical fix after reviewing the potential merge result and accepting the bounded fetch behavior.

options.title: Pick A Sibling Candidate
options.body: Fresh-review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93243 instead if maintainers prefer that branch's shape, then close this PR as superseded after the sibling merges.

options.title: Pause For Owner Direction
options.body: Hold all candidate PRs until a Mattermost/session owner chooses the permanent recovery semantics and fetch budget.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Land This Candidate
recommendation.body: Use this proof-sufficient branch as the canonical fix after reviewing the potential merge result and accepting the bounded fetch behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the shared pending-history/session behavior that steipete recently refactored and the Mattermost plugin path touched here.
